AboutUs.title: About Us
AboutUs.subtitle: What's Here in Izmir?
AboutUs.p1: Izmir Here is a comprehensive digital platform established to improve Izmir and its wider community. By bringing all the services, events, and opportunities the city offers under one roof, we aim to serve everyone who lives or visits Izmir.
AboutUs.p2: Improving daily life in Izmir, providing the easiest access to all the city's options and management. By democratizing access to information, we ensure everyone can make the most of Izmir.
AboutUs.p3: To be Izmir's digital guide, combining all the city's resources on a single platform to become Türkiye's most useful city guide. To meet modern living conditions by integrating cities with technology.
AboutUs.p4: Bus, steam timetables, and route information
